title: Pediatric Clinical Dosage Safety & Dual-Signoff Guard
required_invariants: weight_kg <= 0 or dose_mg <= 0 or max_mg_per_kg <= 0 must raise ValueError.
If patient_has_allergy is True, return status='blocked_allergy'.
If dose_mg > weight_kg * max_mg_per_kg, return status='blocked_overdose'.
If dose_mg > 0.8 * weight_kg * max_mg_per_kg, return status='pharmacist_dual_check'; else 'approved'.
